meta.note: Every value is a gap f - f*. Each generation: e = evaluations after it, gap = the best gap so far; pts and f its candidates and their gaps; m, s, C the state it was drawn from (ES: the parent and sigma; CMA-ES: the mean, sigma and C, whose distribution is N(m, s^2 C); CE: the mean and covariance); v (PSO) the velocities after the generation (from the second generation on, the steps that brought the particles to pts; in the first, their initial velocities); pop and pf (DE) the population after selection and its gaps. C lists the entries (1,1), (1,2), (2,2). gp: Bayesian optimisation's surrogate mean (as a gap) and standard deviation on a grid of the box after the given number of evaluations, row by row in x2.
